text:
Predicates:
SupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is supervised learning.
UnsupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is unsupervised learning.
ReinforcementLearning(x) ::: x is reinforcement learning.
RequiresLabelledData(x) ::: x requires labelled data.
TrainedWith(x, y) ::: x is trained with y.
StateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel(x) ::: x is the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
Premises:
SupervisedLearning(machineLearningAlgorithm) ∨ UnsupervisedLearning(machineLearningAlgorithm) ∨ ReinforcementLearning(machineLearningAlgorithm) ::: Machine Learning algorithms can be categorized as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning.
¬RequiresLabelledData(UnsupervisedLearning) ::: Unsupervised learning doesn't require labelled data.
TrainedWith(stateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel, machineLearningAlgorithms) ::: The state-of-the-art text summarization model is trained with machine learning algorithms.
¬TrainedWith(stateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel, ReinforcementLearning) ::: Reinforcement learning is not used to train the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
RequiresLabelledData(machineLearningAlgorithm) ::: The Machine Learning algorithm for training text summarization model requires labelled data.
Conclusion:
TrainedWith(stateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel, SupervisedLearning) ::: Supervised learning is used to train the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
